transport: HTTP-01 GET / response body; Nostr relays per NOSTR-01 (reserved)
spec_refs: tollgate#22 (merged): min_steps default and per-mint precedence

step_size.value: positive integer, in the metric's unit

min_steps.value: positive whole number; advertisement-level minimum purchase. A per-mint min_steps on a price_per_step entry takes precedence for that pricing option. Absent means 1.
min_steps.spec_note: tollgate#22: an absent value or 0 MUST be treated as 1 (known clients reject min_steps=0 advertisements, so flooring keeps such advertisements purchasable)

price_per_step.required: zero or more (TIP-02: one per accepted mint)
invariants: price MUST be identical across all occurrences of the same unit
min_steps positive whole number, default 1, 0 MUST be treated as 1

vectors.input: GET / on the reference implementation in full service
advertisement carrying a price_per_step entry with min_steps '0' or absent

assert.consumer_rule: treat as 1; never reject the advertisement

evidence.ref: tollgate#22 (merged into TIP-02): absent or 0 MUST be treated as 1 — known clients reject min_steps=0

vectors.input: GET / while no accepted mint is reachable

assert.substituted_by: kind 21023 notice, level=warning, code=no-reachable-mints (see notice-21023.json and http01-discovery.json)
assert.client_rule: a Notice MUST be accepted wherever a Discovery event would normally arrive

evidence.observed: degraded notice served in the advertisement slot

evidence.ref: tollgate#27: the TollGate MAY answer the advertisement slot with a no-reachable-mints warning notice; recovery is automatic and carries no protocol message
